metadata.scenario: A new customer questions a double charge on their statement and requests a review of the transaction history. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Mark Johnson. I'm calling because I noticed a double charge on my statement. I'm sorry to hear that, Mark. Let’s get that sorted out. Can you provide me with your account details? Sure, my phone number is +13165555832, and my last name is Johnson. Thank you, Mark. Let me pull up your account… Okay, I see your recent transactions. Can you tell me which charges seem to be duplicated? Yes, I see two charges for medication management services from last week. They both show up for the same date. I understand your concern. Let me take a closer look at those charges. One moment, please. Sure, take your time. I just want to make sure I'm not being overcharged here. I appreciate your patience, Mark. I see that we did process two transactions for the same service. I will flag this for review. Thank you, Margaret. I really hope this can be fixed. Absolutely, I’ll make sure it gets reviewed. I’ll also keep you updated via email. What’s the best address for you? It's mark.johnson@email.com. Got it, Mark. I’ll send a confirmation and any updates regarding the review. I appreciate that. While I have you, could you tell me more about the transportation services you offer? Sure! Our transportation services range from $45 to $65 per trip and cover medical appointments as well as essential errands. That sounds great. My parents will need help getting to their appointments. I can set up a care plan for your parents that includes medication management and transportation. Would you like to discuss that? Yes, let’s definitely go ahead with that. Perfect! I’ll connect you with our Care Coordinator, Lisa. She can help with scheduling and insurance questions. Sounds good. I look forward to speaking with her. Great! I’ll also follow up on the billing issue and make sure you’re notified as soon as possible. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You’re very welcome, Mark. Have a wonderful day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
